content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: a role=tab button on Sales Invoice (new) appears to route the user to Customer (list), because each round trip starts 1.3\u20132.3 s after a tab-button focus (271 before the first trip in Sc39bbfef, 549 before the second; 272 and 548 in the other sessions) and the return to Sales Invoice (new) follows about 2 s later (app:2, app:4).", "fix": "Fix: On the Sales Invoice (new) screen, identify the role=tab button that is focused just before each navigation to Customer (list) and stop it from navigating away; if it is meant to pick a customer, render that picker inline on the form instead of routing to the Customer list.", "cited_event_ids": ["271", "549", "272", "548", "app:1", "app:2", "app:3", "app:4"], "confidence": "low", "unsupported": ["No click event precedes the customer:list navigations in the windows, so the tab focus is only a temporal match, not a confirmed trigger.", "The tab button's label, handler, and target route are not in the events.", "Why the user returns to Sales Invoice (new) after about 2 s is not shown.", "In Se60cda83 and Sa6cc5b48 the pattern holds only partly: Sa6cc5b48 has no tab focus before its second Customer (list) navigation at app:3 (10328 ms), and Sc39bbfef's first trip is 2.3 s after focus, outside the 1.3\u20132.0 s range.", "Console errors appear near each navigation (7, 285, 562, 609) but their link to the round trips is not established.", "The 3.9 s median time lost is taken from the insight facts and was not verified from the windows."]}
